quiz.metodo: elastic energy, not endpoint force times extension

quiz.criterio_e_esclusioni: Two parallel interface normals and the same external medium return the original angle; lateral displacement does not change direction.
Magnetic force is perpendicular to velocity and does zero work; no energy increase, decrease, zeroing or oscillation follows.
Equal-distance positive-charge fields have equal magnitudes and opposite directions at the midpoint; vector sum vanishes.
Both have initial vertical velocity zero and the same vertical acceleration; horizontal velocity does not change fall time over level ground.
A stationary interface preserves source frequency; lower propagation speed therefore decreases wavelength.
quiz.risposta: Frequenza uguale e lunghezza d’onda minore

quiz.criterio_e_esclusioni: Driving near natural frequency supplies energy coherently; mass, gravity and natural period do not vanish.
quiz.risposta: Il trasferimento di energia è favorito dalla risonanza

quiz.criterio_e_esclusioni: Faraday induction depends on flux change; constant flux gives zero emf regardless of merely present field.
Cylindrical symmetry and the right-hand rule give circles in transverse planes, not radial, axial or terminating lines.
quiz.risposta: Circonferenze attorno al filo in piani perpendicolari

quiz.criterio_e_esclusioni: A sustained nonzero field would move free charges and violate electrostatic equilibrium inside the material.
Equal endpoint potentials imply W=-q deltaV=0; electrostatic path length is irrelevant.
